description: Alice prefers morning shifts and would like to avoid night shifts whenever possible. She is not available on Sundays. Her preferred rest day is Saturday.
Bruno can work during weekends but not on consecutive holidays. He tolerates night shifts and is available for emergency coverage twice a month.
Carla prefers afternoon shifts. She does not mind night shifts but would like Christmas day off if possible.
Davide prefers morning shifts. He strongly dislikes night shifts and is unavailable on Mondays.
Elena has no strong shift preferences. She accepts all shift types and holiday work. Preferred rest day is Wednesday.
Francesco prefers afternoon and night shifts. He is available on holidays and is willing to cover up to three emergency shifts per month.
Giulia prefers morning shifts and would like to avoid working on weekends. She has low tolerance for night shifts.
Hector accepts any shift type. He prefers to have Thursdays as rest days. He is comfortable with night and holiday shifts.
Irene prefers afternoon shifts. She would like to avoid night shifts but can handle one or two per month if needed.
Luca has no strong preferences. He is available all days and tolerates all shift types. He sees himself as a flexible team player.
Marco is a specialized doctor. He prefers morning shifts and has low tolerance for consecutive night shifts. He is unavailable on Sundays.
Nadia is a specialist. She prefers afternoon shifts and is comfortable with holiday work. Preferred rest day is Friday.
Omar works as a specialist. He has no strong preferences and is available for emergency coverage up to three times a month.
Paola is a specialized nurse. She prefers morning and avoids night shifts. She is unavailable on Tuesdays.
Quirino is a specialist who prefers afternoon shifts. He tolerates night shifts with low frequency and accepts holiday work.
Rosa is a specialized technician. She has a strong preference for morning shifts and does not want to work on weekends or holidays.
